conditional_hypothesis.formula_sources: Canonical REQ005 denominator/poles and REQ007 d=8/T; retained report-resonator section4 exact W0 bits.
conditional_hypothesis.numeric_policy: Explicit binary32 rounding at each written operation for w/theta/d/alpha/a1/a2; host binary64 sin/cos rounded tobinary32; pi rounded tobinary32. Extract poles from resulting binary32 coefficients using binary64 sqrt/acos/log. This is a stated mathematical/rounding approximation, NOT proven original operation order/FMA/libm/ABI or actual coefficient readback. A(whole octave)=2 follows the stated formula; no doubled old fitted centers used.

navigation_fixed_before_any_fits.centers: Derived once from the above p1 hypothesis, all16 perchannel; never adjusted to measured peaks.
navigation_fixed_before_any_fits.regular_mode_gap_check: 100<=0.4*minimum adjacent hypothetical pole gap; if not valid, stop without selecting another cutoff. Also report actual nearest significant fitted regular-mode gaps; any invalid100Hz result is exposed, not silently changed.
navigation_fixed_before_any_fits.eligibility: Report abs(reference fit-center)/center<=1e-4 for every mode and bothchannels. Relative amplitude>=1e-3 marks significant modes. No failed mode is silently omitted from the whole16-mode self/wrong comparison.
